contract:
Desktop static profile. It gets the same rules as B16m, plus the static fakes and the search comment.

1. Campus picker (:7050-7161; markup :3365-3367; CSS comments :396-399)
- Delete the copied IU_CAMPUSES (:7065-7075), _campusOptionText and _canonicalCampusLabel.
- On owner load and when edit mode opens, fetch GET /api/campuses once (credentials include) and cache {system, campuses, currentCampusId}. Do not add a third static CAMPUS_ROWS mirror: onboarding.html:589-640 is already one.
- The picker cannot rely on profile-html-bridge.tsx:62, which stores only vibeUser.
- Option value = id; text = (c.shared ? SYSTEM_LABEL + ' ' + c.shortName : c.name) + (c.isOpen ? '' : ' (not open yet)').
- No 'Not set' option once a campus exists; a disabled 'Pick your campus' placeholder when currentCampusId is null.
- /api/campuses failing: show the display text only, no select, never 'Not set'.
- Display chip: the badge text from vibeUser.studentVerification.school, the server-rendered campusBadge.
- Hint :3367: replace with "Your campus community: its clubs, events and map. Indianapolis is one community for IU and Purdue students." (verbatim with B16m/B15), plus sharedWith for a shared pick.
- Cooldown: read campusChangeAvailableAt from the top-level profile-bootstrap at the two adoption sites (:7301 and :8202, stored as u._campusChangeAvailableAt). When it is in the future, disable the select and show "You can change campus again on {Month D}."

2. Payload (buildProfileSyncPayload :7819, campus block :7862-7872)
- Remove `payload.school` and the `_campusCleared` flag (:7154, :8203-8204).
- Send `campus_id` only when u._campusPick is set (written by _onCampusChange :7143) and differs from the last server campusId (u._campusId, adopted at :7301/:8202).
- After a successful sync adoption, clear _campusPick.
- If the sync response carries campusError, window.vibeToast(campusError.error, {tone:'error'}), revert the select to the server campus and clear _campusPick. A non-ok campus-only response toasts j.error.
- Never send ''.

3. Majors (_populateMajorPicker :7548-7571, _hydrateMajorPicker :7572+)
- Build from window.vibeMajorsForCampus(campusId, system): optgroups from list.groups (shortLabel), a flat list when groups is empty.
- When the result is null, swap the select for a free-text input with the same onchange → _onMajorYearChange.
- Re-populate when the campus pick changes (drop the populated==='1' early-return, or reset it).
- Keep the 'saved major not in list' option.

4. Fake calendar events
- Delete the seedEvents IIFE (:6729-6737).
- Add a one-time purge inside _calLoad (:6881-6890) BEFORE merging. From the parsed vibe_cal_events_v1 object, drop entries whose (name, location) pair is one of:
  - ('IU Spring Career Fair','IMU Alumni Hall')
  - ('Goldman Sachs Info Session','Kelley School of Business 100')
  - ('Weekly Design Critique','Luddy Hall 1106')
  - ('IU Hackathon 2025','Assembly Hall')
- Delete empty date keys, then write the cleaned object back.
- The key is shared with messages.html:1633, and B20 adds the identical purge there.
- The placeholder at :9188 ('e.g. Goldman Sachs Info Session') may stay or become 'e.g. Club info session'.

5. Search (§5.6)
- Delete the obsolete comment at :6395-6397 ("orgs don't have a public follow API yet — joining is gated on the org page itself"). Replace it with a one-liner: "Org rows navigate (View); following and joining live on the org page."
- In _profSearchOrgToRow (:6398-6412) append ' · Invite only' when o.join_policy==='invite', ' · IU only' / ' · Purdue only' when o.audience is 'iu' / 'purdue'. Write it tolerant: /api/search does not return these fields yet, so the suffix renders nothing until B10-extended ships.
- Keep member_count (the browse-card follower-count ban is about followers).

6. Comments: rewrite :383-384, :396-399, :7051-7064 and :7543-7547 system-neutral.

Post edit: none in this file. Edit lives in public/html/_postViewer.js, which profile.html opens and which belongs to no batch; the owner card × at :8713 stays.
acceptance: Extract every inline <script> (skip src= and type=application/json) into the scratchpad; node --check each → all pass.
rg -n "IU_CAMPUSES|_campusCleared|payload.school|public follow API|Not verified — change it any time" public/html/profile.html → 0.
rg -n "IU Spring Career Fair|IU Hackathon 2025" public/html/profile.html → hits only inside the purge list constant.

Purge test in the Browser pane: seed localStorage.vibe_cal_events_v1 with one fake + one real event, reload /html/profile.html?app=1 → only the real event remains and the stored JSON no longer has the fake.

1280px screenshots, edit mode: IU picker (shared sub-line), Purdue picker (/api/campuses override with system:'purdue'), cooldown (bootstrap override), campusError toast (profile-sync override). No real campus writes from agents.
Profile search 'sae' under an override returning join_policy:'invite' → row meta '1 members · Invite only' (or the member count), and nothing extra without the fields.
